edition.title: NPNF Second Series, Volume I: Eusebius Pamphilus: Church History, Life of Constantine, Oration in Praise of Constantine

alternate_titles: Eusebius: Church History, Life of Constantine the Great, and Oration in Praise of Constantine
work.author: Philip Schaff and Henry Wace
work.description: The first volume of the second series of the Nicene and Post-Nicene Fathers translation anthology, containing Arthur Cushman McGiffert's annotated English translation of Eusebius's Church History together with the Constantinian works translated by Ernest Cushing Richardson. Its container identity remains distinct from Eusebius's works and the translated editions printed within it.
work.title: A Select Library of Nicene and Post-Nicene Fathers, Second Series, Volume I
